entities.name: Cristoforo Guidalotti Ciocchi del Monte
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cristoforo Guidalotti Ciocchi del Monte (1484–1564) was an Italian Roman Catholic bishop and cardinal. On his mother's side, he was a first cousin of Pope Julius III.
